visual_mismatch_ledger.observation: The U opening is now structurally integrated but reads as a deep architectural arch, not the small rounded feet/open space of the compact clock.
The intermediate section produces a readable A-frame rollover instead of a slab, but its facets and slope still need closer matching to the reference's compact molded-plastic profile.
The connected shell has a more plausible folded volume, but large planar front and side fields make it look like a generic blockout rather than the target product.

retained_learning: A third authored depth section directly improved the highest-salience side silhouette.
Correct topology and an improved side profile do not validate the front negative space or molded-surface character.
No display, button, material, crease, SubD, or bevel work is justified until the primary shell and feet are rebuilt to the reference.
required_next_action: Re-measure the front lower-foot geometry and add locally controlled face distribution to the existing connected cage before another visual review.
disposition_boundary: This is a technical and visual repair record, not acceptance or a professional-fidelity claim.
